--- title: "Configuration" description: "All config paths: direct kwargs, environment variables, YAML files, and dictionaries — nested vs flat format." date: today format: html: self-contained: true embed-resources: true code-fold: true code-tools: true --- ## Introduction nano-graphrag offers four ways to configure the system, each suited to different workflows: | Method | Best for | Example | |--------|----------|---------| | **Direct kwargs** | Scripts, notebooks, quick experiments | `GraphRAG(llm_model="ollama/llama3.2")` | | **Environment variables** | Docker, CI/CD, 12-factor apps | `GRAPH_API_KEY=... LLM_MODEL=...` | | **YAML file** | Reproducible configs, team sharing | `GraphRAGConfig.from_yaml("settings.yaml")` | | **Dictionary** | Programmatic construction, testing | `GraphRAGConfig.from_dict({...})` | This notebook demonstrates each method and shows they produce equivalent configurations. ## Setup ::: {#setup .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import os import logging import tempfile from pathlib import Path logging.basicConfig(level=logging.WARNING) logging.getLogger("nano-graphrag").setLevel(logging.INFO) WORKING_DIR = Path("./_cache/02_configuration") WORKING_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) ``` ::: ::: {#imports .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} from nano_graphrag import GraphRAG, QueryParam from nano_graphrag.base import GraphRAGConfig from nano_graphrag._config import GraphRAGSettings ``` ::: ## Method 1: Direct Constructor Keyword Arguments The simplest approach — pass configuration directly to the `GraphRAG` constructor. Every setting has a sensible default, so you only need to override what differs. ::: {#method-kwargs .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} rag_kwargs = GraphRAG( working_dir=str(WORKING_DIR / "kwargs"), enable_llm_cache=True, chunk_token_size=1200, chunk_overlap_token_size=100, ) print("Created via kwargs:") print(f" working_dir: {rag_kwargs.working_dir}") print(f" llm_model: {rag_kwargs.llm_model}") print(f" embedding_dim: {rag_kwargs.embedding_dim}") print(f" chunk_size: {rag_kwargs.chunk_token_size}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ::: {.ansi-escaped-output} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` GraphRAG from env config: openrouter/google/gemma-4-31b-it ``` ::: ::: ## Method 3: YAML File YAML configs support two formats: **nested** (structured by section) and **flat** (all keys at the top level). Both are accepted. ### Nested Format (Recommended) ::: {#yaml-nested .cell execution_count=8} ``` {.python .cell-code} nested_yaml = """ working_dir: ./nano_graphrag llm: model: openrouter/google/gemma-4-31b-it cheap_model: openrouter/google/gemma-4-31b-it max_async: 16 embedding: model: openrouter/qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b dim: 4096 extraction: batch_size: 5 quality: balanced features: local_search: true naive_rag: false llm_cache: true """ nested_path = WORKING_DIR / "nested_settings.yaml" nested_path.write_text(nested_yaml) config_nested = GraphRAGConfig.from_yaml(str(nested_path)) print("Nested YAML config:") print(f" llm_model: {config_nested.llm_model}") print(f" embedding_dim: {config_nested.embedding_dim}") print(f" extraction_batch_size: {config_nested.extraction_batch_size}") print(f" enable_local: {config_nested.enable_local}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Nested YAML config: llm_model: openrouter/google/gemma-4-31b-it embedding_dim: 4096 extraction_batch_size: 5 enable_local: True ``` ::: ::: ### Flat Format (Legacy Compatible) ::: {#yaml-flat .cell execution_count=9} ``` {.python .cell-code} flat_yaml = """ working_dir: ./nano_graphrag llm_model: openrouter/google/gemma-4-31b-it llm_cheap_model: openrouter/google/gemma-4-31b-it embedding_model: openrouter/qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b embedding_dim: 4096 extraction_batch_size: 5 enable_local: true enable_naive_rag: false """ flat_path = WORKING_DIR / "flat_settings.yaml" flat_path.write_text(flat_yaml) config_flat = GraphRAGConfig.from_yaml(str(flat_path)) print("Flat YAML config:") print(f" llm_model: {config_flat.llm_model}") print(f" embedding_dim: {config_flat.embedding_dim}") print(f" enable_local: {config_flat.enable_local}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Flat YAML config: llm_model: openrouter/google/gemma-4-31b-it embedding_dim: 4096 enable_local: True ``` ::: ::: ## Method 4: Dictionary Useful for programmatic construction or when loading config from databases APIs. ::: {#method-dict .cell execution_count=10} ``` {.python .cell-code} config_dict_flat = { "working_dir": str(WORKING_DIR / "dict"), "llm_model": "openrouter/google/gemma-4-31b-it", "embedding_dim": 4096, "enable_llm_cache": True, } config_from_dict = GraphRAGConfig.from_dict(config_dict_flat) print("Dict config (flat):") print(f" llm_model: {config_from_dict.llm_model}") print(f" embedding_dim: {config_from_dict.embedding_dim}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Dict config (flat): llm_model: openrouter/google/gemma-4-31b-it embedding_dim: 4096 ``` ::: ::: ### Nested Dict ::: {#method-dict-nested .cell execution_count=11} ``` {.python .cell-code} config_dict_nested = { "working_dir": str(WORKING_DIR / "dict_nested"), "llm": { "model": "openrouter/google/gemma-4-31b-it", "max_async": 16, }, "embedding": { "model": "openrouter/qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b", "dim": 4096, }, "features": { "local_search": True, "llm_cache": True, }, } config_from_nested = GraphRAGConfig.from_dict(config_dict_nested) print("Dict config (nested):") print(f" llm_model: {config_from_nested.llm_model}") print(f" embedding_dim: {config_from_nested.embedding_dim}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Dict config (nested): llm_model: openrouter/google/gemma-4-31b-it embedding_dim: 4096 ``` ::: ::: ## Merging Configs Use `.merge()` to override specific settings on an existing config: ::: {#merge-config .cell execution_count=12} ``` {.python .cell-code} base_config = GraphRAGConfig.from_env() overridden = base_config.merge({ "working_dir": str(WORKING_DIR / "merged"), "extraction_batch_size": 10, }) print("Merged config:") print(f" working_dir: {overridden.working_dir}") print(f" extraction_batch_size: {overridden.extraction_batch_size}") print(f" llm_model (inherited): {overridden.llm_model}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Merged config: working_dir: _cache/02_configuration/merged extraction_batch_size: 10 llm_model (inherited): openrouter/google/gemma-4-31b-it ``` ::: ::: ## Safe Logging Use `_to_safe_log_dict()` to serialize configuration for logging without leaking API keys: ::: {#safe-logging .cell execution_count=13} ``` {.python .cell-code} rag_safe = GraphRAG( working_dir=str(WORKING_DIR / "safe_log"), enable_llm_cache=True, ) safe = rag_safe._to_safe_log_dict() print("Safe log dict (secrets redacted, callables summarized):") for k, v in sorted(safe.items()): if v is not None and v != False and v != 0 and v != "": print(f" {k:40s} = {v}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ::: {.ansi-escaped-output} ```{=html}
